build-ai-commerce.title: AI-Powered Commerce and Logistics
build-ai-commerce.summary: Choose online retail, a multi-vendor marketplace or logistics services. Practise with fictional data, checked calculations and human review before considering a live business.
steps: Choose a model and gather actual customer evidence
Check platform, access and responsibility requirements
Practise AI-assisted drafts and deterministic calculations
Review exceptions, costs and human approval
Deliver a labelled prototype before planning live operations

scope-freelance-project.title: Freelance Client Discovery & Project Scoping
scope-freelance-project.summary: Ask neutral questions, check evidence and define a bounded scope before drafting an offer. Practice does not approve real work.
steps: Review skills, permissions and project fit

offer-content-services.title: AI Content Services
offer-content-services.summary: Create a fictional client content package, check claims and permissions, manage revisions and plan delivery.
steps: Draft and verify a content package
Scope, cost and deliver the service

offer-cad-services.title: AI + CAD Concept Services
offer-cad-services.summary: Prepare a non-functional display-card concept with consistent dimensions, versioned views and clear exclusions.
steps: Model or document a paper alternative
Review revisions and hand over concept evidence

validate-micro-saas.title: Micro-SaaS Validation
validate-micro-saas.summary: Validate a narrow problem with a local-only formatter prototype, boundary tests and honest user evidence.
steps: Specify and prototype a tiny service
Observe use and decide before launch

offer-education-services.title: AI Education Services
offer-education-services.summary: Prepare an original adult workshop with source-checked materials, a practice rubric and accessible delivery.
steps: Create original materials and a checked key
Scope the workshop and improve from evidence

start-ai-business.title: AI Workflow Automation for Small Business
start-ai-business.summary: Practise customer enquiry tracking, appointment reminder automation or automated weekly business reports. Validate demand and inspect fictional results before connecting real accounts.
steps: Build and test a fictional enquiry demo
Calculate costs and prepare an honest offer
Plan handover and review the evidence

learn-ai.title: AI for Beginners
learn-ai.summary: Start with AI basics, prompt writing, and simple real-world workflows before moving into deeper tool usage.

build-website.title: Website Builder Path
build-website.summary: Learn the essential steps for designing, creating, and publishing a simple website without feeling lost.

automate-work.title: Automation Starter
automate-work.summary: Use beginner-friendly tools to reduce repetitive tasks and improve the way you work.

learn-coding.title: Coding Foundations
learn-coding.summary: Learn the basics of coding and use small projects to build confidence before deeper learning.
steps: Use AI to explain and review your code

learn-ml.title: Machine Learning Foundations
learn-ml.summary: Understand the big ideas behind ML, data patterns, and beginner-friendly experiments.

design-cad.title: Design and CAD Path
design-cad.summary: Use design thinking and simple CAD tools to build creative ideas and prototypes with confidence.

build-app.title: App Building Path
build-app.summary: Start with simple app ideas, product thinking, and the tools that help you build a first version.
steps: Define the idea and tiny scope
Build a prototype with an AI coding assistant

no-code.title: No-Code Starter
no-code.summary: Use easy tools to build workflows and small systems without needing to write code.

ai-productivity.title: AI Productivity Path
ai-productivity.summary: Learn how AI can support writing, planning, research, and daily work in a practical way.

create-content.title: Content Creation Path
create-content.summary: Plan an idea, draft it with AI, add visuals or voice, then polish it in your own voice before you share.

analyze-data.title: Data Analysis Path
analyze-data.summary: Learn to import, plot, measure and report on measurement data such as pump logs and scanner maps. Use Origin for graphs, or automate the analysis with Python scripts and AI assistants.
steps: Map scans, then template and report

visualize-data.title: Data Visualization Path
visualize-data.summary: Use clear charts to answer questions about data. Start with clean tables, choose a chart, create it in Python or Colab and explain its limits.

research-ai.title: Research Prompting Path
research-ai.summary: Use AI to narrow research questions, organize evidence and draft synthesis, while verifying original sources and every citation yourself.
steps: Verify and cite the final brief

ai-education.title: AI for Teachers and Students Path
ai-education.summary: Use AI for lesson planning, tutoring and practice without sharing personal student data or handing over human judgement and learning.
steps: Plan a lesson or study with a tutor
Reflect on and disclose AI use

ai-small-business.title: Small Business Content Path
ai-small-business.summary: Start with real customer evidence, draft useful content and check every claim before sharing.
steps: Define an offer and research customer needs
Plan, review and measure a small campaign

create-business-videos.title: Create Short-Form Videos with AI for Business
create-business-videos.summary: Plan three fictional business videos, write scripts and captions, check finished exports and prepare an honest service offer. AI generation is optional; no views, sales or client approval are promised.
steps: Write AI-assisted video scripts and storyboards

ai-career.title: Career Skills Path
ai-career.summary: Use real experience to prepare applications and interview practice, then plan a manageable skill-building project.
steps: Match a role to real evidence
Tailor a resume and cover letter
Track applications and choose a learning goal
